A VPN is a private connection between your device and the internet. It wraps your traffic in encryption and sends it through another computer before it reaches the website you want.

Because of this, people on the same Wi-Fi, like at a café or airport, can't easily see what you do. Websites see the VPN's address instead of yours, which hides your rough location.

A VPN doesn't make you anonymous. The VPN company can still see your traffic, and it won't stop viruses or scams, so pick one you trust.

VPN ek private raasta hai jo aapke device aur internet ke beech banta hai. Yeh aapka data lock karke ek doosre computer se guzaarta hai, phir website tak pahunchata hai.

Public Wi-Fi par, jaise café ya airport mein, doosre log aapki activity aasani se nahi dekh paate. Website ko VPN ka address dikhta hai, aapka nahi, isliye aapki lagbhag location chhup jaati hai.

VPN aapko poori tarah anonymous nahi banata. VPN company aapka traffic dekh sakti hai, aur yeh virus ya scam se nahi bachata, isliye bharosemand VPN chunein.

कैफ़े या एयरपोर्ट के पब्लिक वाई-फ़ाई पर दूसरे लोग आपकी गतिविधि आसानी से नहीं देख पाते। वेबसाइट को वीपीएन का पता दिखता है, आपका नहीं, इसलिए आपकी लगभग लोकेशन छिपी रहती है।
